title: Internships Open This Week: Aug 19–Aug 26, 2026
summary: 1072 internship positions across 357 companies in 14 industries, all verified live within the last 48 hours. Direct application links and company guides included.
body_markdown:
You are in! We will send you new internship openings every week.

This week, **357 companies** opened new internship positions across **14 industries** .


Every listing below links directly to the company's application page. For interview tips, salary data, and application timelines, click the Guide link next to each company.


**A note on these listings:** This is our weekly roundup of new internship openings across hundreds of companies. If you don't see a specific company, they may not have posted new roles this week, or we may not have caught it yet. Take a look around anyway. Some of the best internships come from companies you weren't originally considering. We verify that each position is live and link directly to company career portals, but postings move fast and can change without notice. We are not affiliated with any of the companies listed. Always confirm details on their careers page before you apply.

** Profile Match · Extern Data


### Could You Get In at a Top Tech Company? *Compare Your Profile*


Based on 403 software engineering interns who started their first software internship between 2024 and 2026 (public LinkedIn profiles, aggregated). Six questions, under a minute.


** ** ** ** ** **


Question 1 of 6


#### Which summer are you applying for?


Recruiting timelines differ by class year, so we compare you with the right group.


Question 2 of 6


#### Which group is your school closest to?


Firms recruit on campus in tiers. We match you against admits from schools like yours.


Question 3 of 6


#### Is your major computer science, software engineering, data science or electrical engineering?


Almost every software intern in our data studied one of these. Other majors get in, but the coursework has to show elsewhere.


Question 4 of 6


#### How many internships, externships or research positions have you held so far?


Count anything with a real employer, mentor or principal investigator attached. Retail and food service do not count.


Question 5 of 6


#### Has any of that experience been tech-related?


Software, data, IT, engineering or a research lab. Any size of company counts.


Question 6 of 6


#### Do you have at least one project on your resume or LinkedIn?


Personal, class, hackathon or open-source projects all count.


**** of admits
